MLA Cuts Gourd While Campaigning for Local Elections

During campaigning for urban local body elections, MLA Bhagchand Takda was seen cutting a gourd. The incident occurred when the MLA, seeking votes, took a knife from a woman and began slicing the vegetable. This occurred in Dausa.
